caseNameFull: Slocum v. First National Bank of Chicago
attorneys: Mr. Meyer Abrams for petitioners. Messrs. Max Swiren and Frank H. Towner for the First National Bank et aL; and Mr. Claire W. Hardy for A. C. Allyn & Co., respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Appellate Court, 1st District, of Illinois, denied.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
